We are sorry to read that you are unhappy with the service being provided and the attitude of our staff. 
Routine appointments both telephone and face to face are normally available one to two weeks in advance. Looking at the system this morning there are appointments available to book at the end of next week.  For emergency appointments there is always a duty Dr available Monday to Friday 8.00am to 6.30pm.  If urgent care is required a call back from the Dr will be arranged, they will telephone the patient and then arrange a face to face appointment if required.
The reopening of Lake Street has been delayed until Monday 6th February 2023.  There is an update regarding this on the website under latest news.  We did have limited opening on Friday's during January, however this wasn't possible on the 17th and 24th January as there were further technical issues.  The building is due to be handed back to us from the contractors tomorrow 3rd February and we are putting every effort into the branch surgery being reopen on the 6th.  We do appreciate how difficult it has been with our Lake Street branch being closed, however for the safety of both patients and staff we were unable to continue to work from that building,  all our services have remained available at our main site on Manzil Way.
If you still require an appointment please do contact the surgery.

Kind Regards

Jo Hearle
Deputy Practice Manager
